plugins.name: CoolROM
plugins.author: MoveWeight
plugins.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED AND NOT SURVEYED. coolrom.com's robots.txt explicitly disallows anthropic-ai and Claude-Web, so the agent that surveyed the other six sites stopped at robots.txt and inspected no pages. The site's structure is therefore unknown rather than difficult.
plugins.terms: This repository records why a survey was not performed. It fetches, indexes and redistributes nothing.
plugins.comments: Known from robots.txt alone: the site is behind Cloudflare but serves robots.txt cleanly, so there is no blanket managed challenge. A generic client falls under User-agent: *, which allows the site at Crawl-delay: 10 and disallows /cr-admin/, /members/, /admin/, /api/, /ads/ and /queue.php. Unknown: listing shape, id scheme, region/size metadata, download flow, and whether files are still served. Buildable in principle by a non-Anthropic surveyor; honour the 10-second crawl delay and model it on romarr-plugin-retrostic.
